description: This file manages MCP runtime sessions, including creation, disposal, and communication with MCP servers, utilizing client transports, session management, and configuration loading.

classes.name: BundleMcpSession
classes.description: Represents an MCP session with server name, client, transport, and optional stderr detachment.

classes.name: LoadedMcpConfig
classes.description: Type representing the loaded MCP configuration with diagnostics.

classes.name: SessionMcpRuntime
classes.description: Interface for managing an MCP runtime session, including calling tools and disposal.

classes.name: SessionMcpRuntimeManager
classes.description: Interface for managing multiple MCP runtime sessions, including creation, resolution, and disposal.

methods.name: connectWithTimeout
methods.description: Establishes a client connection with a timeout.

methods.name: redactErrorUrls
methods.description: Redacts URLs from error messages for security.

methods.name: listAllTools
methods.description: Lists all tools available from a client, handling pagination.

methods.name: disposeSession
methods.description: Disposes of a session, closing client and transport.

methods.name: createCatalogFingerprint
methods.description: Creates a SHA1 hash fingerprint of server configurations.

methods.name: loadSessionMcpConfig
methods.description: Loads and logs MCP configuration, returning loaded config and fingerprint.

methods.name: createDisposedError
methods.description: Creates an error indicating the MCP runtime has been disposed.

methods.name: createSessionMcpRuntime
methods.description: Creates a new MCP runtime session, managing server connections and tools.

methods.name: createSessionMcpRuntimeManager
methods.description: Creates a manager for handling multiple MCP runtime sessions.

methods.name: getSessionMcpRuntimeManager
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of the session MCP runtime manager.

methods.name: getOrCreateSessionMcpRuntime
methods.description: Gets or creates an MCP runtime session for given parameters.

methods.name: disposeSessionMcpRuntime
methods.description: Disposes of a specific MCP runtime session.
